name: Genevieve Dubois
source: Student of the Volhovia. At first glance, she seems like a sweet quiet one, but she's adventurous and eager to explore everything life has to offer. Under the mask of a diligent student hides an unrestrained nature, who knows what she wants. And yes, she's got a charming smile and gorgeous legs!
